docs.subject: CCTV Monitoring Solution for Smart Parks
docs.terms:
Validity: 30 days from the quotation date.
Scope: Only listed items and services are included. Additional work requires a separate approved quotation.
Payment: 50% advance with LPO; 50% upon installation and commissioning.
Availability: If a quoted model is unavailable or discontinued, an alternative with equivalent or higher specifications will be supplied and installed as per site requirements.

items.name: iDS-2CD7A86G2-IZHS(Y)(/5G)
items.desc:
8MP DeepinView Moto Varifocal Bullet Camera
High quality imaging with 8 MP resolution
Excellent low-light performance via DarkFighter 2.0 technology
Clear imaging against strong back light due to 140 dB AWDR technology
Efficient H.265+ compression technology to save bandwidth and storage
5 streams to meet a wide variety of applications
Water and dust resistant (IP67), vandal proof (IK10) and corrosion resistant (NEMA 4X, optional)
Capture vehicles and humans of different speed clearly via ShotN technology
High frame rate, up to 8MP@60fps and 2MP@120fps
Built-in heater to ensure clear image under rainy or snowy weather
Built-in G-sensor for vibration detection
Built-in power meter for historical power statistics

items.name: DS-7608NXI-G1/4P 8-ch 4 PoE NVR
items.desc:
Operates in extreme temperature ranges from -40°C to 70°C
Integrates algorithms: Face Recognition, Perimeter Protection, Motion Detection 2.0, AcuSeek and AcuSearch
Up to 8-ch AcuSeek and AcuSearch function
Adopt Hikvision AcuSense technology to minimize manual effort and security costs
Accurate perimeter protection effectively reduces false alarms
Automatic cameras connection and configuration
Up to 8-ch IP camera inputs
Up to 3-ch@12 MP or 5-ch@8 MP or 10-ch@4 MP or 20-ch@1080p decoding capacity
H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264 video formats
Up to 80 Mbps incoming bandwidth
Up to 20TB HDD

items.name: HikCentral-P-AcuSeek-1Ch/Advanced
items.desc:
Video Surveillance: 1-ch Video Management
Facial & Human Body Recognition: 1-ch face comparison, human attribute retrieval, Archive Search

items.name: iDS-67128NXI-S/AF(STD)(1×8T)
items.desc:
Fusion AI Station- Analytics
Intelligent analytics based on deep learning algorithm
Up to 128-ch IP cameras can be connected
H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264 video formats
4 RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps self-adaptive Ethernet interfaces
Facial recognition for people not wearing hard hat
PPE detection which including safety helmets and reflective vests
Fire and smoke detection
BA function , falling down detection, people gathering detection, fast moving detection, physical conflict detection
Indoor BA function, playing mobile phone, number of people exception, overstaying detection
